subject: Pilot sweetener: hybrid credit structure and extension request
messages:
From: Sanjay Patel <sanjay@helixsystems.io>
To: irene_choi@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 1 Sep 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot sweetener: ask for extension + credit top-up

Irene —

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. Helix is seeing good quality signals from the POC but we’re hitting token ceiling on our key use cases (batch post-processing + retriever calls). Two asks from our side that would help us get a clear go/no-go inside the next 8 weeks: 

1) A 60-day extension of the current pilot window (we need more time for our integration tests and a second round of user testing).
2) A one-time trial top-up of $25,000 in credits (to cover an estimated ~500k extra tokens plus some embedding spikes).

We’re also evaluating commit economics; if Redwood can combine the top-up with a 10% time-limited discount on month-1 usage post-pilot (applied to first three months after go-live), that materially improves our procurement discussion.

I’ve attached an updated mutual action plan and a very rough SOW so legal can see scope. Goal is to have a procurement-friendly package we can bring to finance by mid-September.

Appreciate any flexibility — we’re excited about Redwood’s latency numbers and want to move faster.

Best,
Sanjay
Director of AI Platforms
Helix Systems
Attachments: Helix_Mutual_Action_Plan.docx, Draft_SOW_v2.pdf
From: irene_choi@redwood.ai
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai, david_kim@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 2 Sep 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Pilot sweetener: ask for extension + credit top-up

Folks — forwarding Helix’s ask (HS-54621). Quick summary: 60-day extension + $25k credit top-up + request for 10% discount on months 1–3 post-go-live. They’re high-touch, latency-sensitive (real-time inference + embeddings), and pushing for procurement by mid-Sept.

Recommended path: 1) Legal to confirm terms/usage windows and any data-handling redlines; 2) Finance to sign off on one-time credit and any discount structure; 3) Exec signoff if total concession exceeds standard credit thresholds.

Why I’m asking: Helix has referenced competitor pricing and needs a short runway — this particular team is likely to convert to a committed deal if we can act quickly and show flexibility.

Please reply with approval, counter, or questions. If we can agree to an approach today I’ll draft the terms and update the MAP for their procurement team.

Thanks — I.

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: irene_choi@redwood.ai, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai, david_kim@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 2 Sep 2026 11:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pilot sweetener: ask for extension + credit top-up

Irene — thanks for the summary. I’m supportive of a modest concession to de-risk the purchase path. My suggested guardrails:

- Approve up to $15,000 one-time credit (applied to pilot usage only).
- Approve a 30-day extension of the pilot by default; a longer extension (60d) is acceptable only if tied to a commitment milestone (e.g., signed SOW or LOI).
- The 10% discount on months 1–3 post-go-live should be conditional on a minimum 6-month paid commitment and must be limited to usage up to 2x their pilot baseline.

Legal (Stephanie) should ensure the MAP/SOW language prevents double-dipping (no overlap with other promotional credits). Finance (David) — can you confirm whether $15k + these conditions are within standard ticket-level approval or if we need exec signoff? If we need exec, I can escalate but would prefer to avoid delaying Helix’s procurement timeline.

—Marissa
VP, Sales Ops

From: david_kim@redwood.ai
To: irene_choi@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 3 Sep 2026 09:24:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pilot sweetener: ask for extension + credit top-up

Team — after reviewing the deal economics and expected uplift from conversion probability, finance can approve a constrained concession:

- One-time pilot credit: $15,000 (to be applied only to current pilot billing).
- Pilot extension: 30 days approved immediately.
- Additional 30-day extension (to reach the 60-day ask) can be granted only after a signed LOI/SOW or a firm verbal commitment with an expected invoice (i.e., procurement has acknowledged intent to buy).
- Post-go-live discount: up to 10% for months 1–3 only if Helix signs a minimum 6-month paid commitment and the monthly usage does not exceed 2x pilot baseline. Finance will cap our exposure to $45k across credits + discounts.

Please have Legal (Stephanie) add explicit anti-double-dip language to the MAP and include start/end dates for credit usage. Also add a clause routing any future requests that would increase the total exposure beyond $45k back to Revenue Ops for exec approval.

Irene — I’ll prepare a short approval note for the deal file and update HS-54621 in HubSpot. If this is acceptable, please send an updated MAP to Sanjay with the conditional language and attach the SOW; we’ll mark the credit as pending until we receive the signed LOI/SOW.

-David
Director of Finance, Revenue
